keyFindings.description: The district layout includes water and roads that may not be clearly distinguishable due to the color scheme. The 'water' color (#007fff) might blend with the background, making it hard for players to identify water areas.
keyFindings.suggestion: Consider using a more distinct color for water or adding texture to differentiate it from other elements.

keyFindings.description: The route provided includes several long stretches of movement (e.g., 102 to 91, 91 to 92), which could be tedious and potentially confusing for players. Long routes without clear landmarks or checkpoints might lead to player frustration.
